caseName: LaChapelle v. Union Pacific Coal Co.
caseNameFull: Flo LaChapelle, as Administratrix, etc. v. Union Pacific Coal Company
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Wyoming.
attorneys: Mr. John A. Shelton for plaintaiff in error. Mr. N. H. Loomis and Mr. John W. Lacey for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6. Petition for certiorari denied.
